steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: So, what do you think about Penguin Logistics, Amiya? We're pretty good, aren't we?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yeah, you're great!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: W-woaaah!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: It feels pretty embarrassing getting complimented by a little girl!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Watch your mouth. She's our client.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Oops, sorry about that!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Don't worry about it. It's you who we should be thanking!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: So, we've met up with Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: What's next?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I might need the L.G.D. to come to a decision before I give my input.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Is that so...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I'll ask them to come take a look over here then.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: This terrain...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Reunion must have lured us here on purpose.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Nothing but sand and rocks in this wasteland. It's got all the makings of one of those movie showdowns.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: The only thing that's missing is the enemy, huh?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hoshiguma, stay here and back up Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hm? Very well.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'll take the L.G.D. and change positions.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: If this stalemate continues, we won't be able to control Reunion's escape routes.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You take care as well.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: --Wooah, that was a really strong wind.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Ugh... The visibility's getting really poor too, I can barely see ahead of me...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Don't go any farther.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Reunion might wait for us to fall into their trap before they attack again.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: We can't let that happen.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: How about this, Amiya.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Liskarm and I will fight for control over the high ground around here and scout out the enemy.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Until we notify you, stay in this position.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Just don't rush out to us even if looks like the fighting is getting intense, Amiya.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I know. I'll make my own judgment call.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Doctor, you keep an eye on her too!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: We'll be in touch.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: The ruins are empty. The high ground is currently undefended.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: That's curious, does Reunion not have any commanders?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Franka, is something wrong?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Those place was supposed to be easy to defend but hard to attack.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: There's no way that Reunion hasn't set up an ambush...

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Die, traitors!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Tch... No sense of honor.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Franka!! Behind you!!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I see Reunion forces coming up from the nearby ruins!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: *cough*... I couldn't see... her sword?!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: How... is that possible...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Haha!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Did you really think you could ambush us from there?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Don't you think you're underestimating me?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: ...Blacksteel...!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Fall back! Hurry!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I really thought there'd be more Reunion goons up here. I was even walking on tiptoes.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Turns out it's just a bunch of cowards. How disappointing.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: You're going to get disappointed over that?!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: More importantly, we have to go after them! Don't let them get away so easily!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Amiya, what do you think?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I think... it's best not to risk it!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Let's let Penguin Logistics stabilize the situation before we decide on the next thing to do.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Exusiai, can you prioritize securing the high ground?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Sure thing! I'm on my way!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Good, continue pressuring the enemy. Don't let Reunion stage a counterattack!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Reunion is trying to regroup after retreating a bit.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: They're... bringing something out!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Watch out.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That thing...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: is no ordinary thug!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I never expected Reunion to be working with...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Could that be...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Working with who?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: You're right, this Reunion soldier does look different...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Could it be...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (Liskarm, we're currently working with the L.G.D.... It's probably not the best time to be talking about sensitive topics!)

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: (Ah, understood.)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (I'll tell you my theory next time!)

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: *yawns*...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Everyone, please get ready!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This... might be a very difficult battle!
